fit: Uncentered SVD of training raw L6 pre-MLP responses. Normalize each training response to unit norm, then normalize each task matrix Frobenius norm before shared fit; task-specific fit uses its own normalized rows. Orthogonal projections; no intercept.
selection: Every third sorted lexical item held out, all variants grouped. Previously examined panels; internal fit holdout, not fresh evidence.
comparisons: Shared rank r vs specific rank r matches active dimension but specific total storage is2r; shared rank2r vs specific rankr matches total storage. No trained sparse gates, taxonomy, or computational DAG.
primary: Heldout causal response fidelity and context-gap preservation, plus input reconstruction. Full source perturbation/recipient baseline retained.
